metadata.title: Viasat Stock Could Be a Takeover Target After Rocket Lab, Iridium Deal<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
This Space Stock Could Be a Takeover Target After Rocket Lab, Iridium Deal
Rocket Lab deal to buy Iridium Communications is a reminder that companies with existing satellite assets are hot property in the new space race. ViaSat might be the next takeover target.
